title: Home Comfort Financing Payoff Per-Diem Day Count
content:
*Payoff desk standard — counting per-diem days on a Home Comfort Financing payoff.*

The payoff per-diem days run from the day the most recent interest charge posted through the day of payoff, both days counted, when that charge posted after the most recent payment; they run from the day after the promotional end date through the day of payoff when the promotion has ended and no interest charge has posted since it ended; otherwise they run from the day after the most recent payment through the day of payoff, or from the funded date through the day of payoff when no payment has posted.

The rows are read from the top; the first that matches the records applies:

| Account records | First per-diem day | Last per-diem day |
|---|---|---|
| a payment has posted, and the most recent interest charge posted on a later day than the most recent payment | the day that interest charge posted | the day of payoff |
| otherwise, the promotion has ended (the plan has a promotional period and the day of payoff is after its promotional end date) and no interest charge has posted after the promotional end date | the day after the promotional end date | the day of payoff |
| otherwise, a payment has posted | the day after the most recent payment | the day of payoff |
| otherwise (no payment has posted) | the funded date | the day of payoff |

The day of payoff is always counted.

## Worked cases (hypothetical accounts, day of payoff 14 October)

1. Most recent payment 10 September; most recent interest charge 1 October. The charge is later than the payment: 1 October through 14 October, 14 days.
2. Promotional end date 31 August; no interest charge since then; most recent payment 15 September. No interest charge is later than the payment, the promotion has ended and no interest has posted since: 1 September through 14 October, 44 days.
3. Promotional end date 31 August; an interest charge posted 1 October; most recent payment 5 October. The charge is not later than the payment, and interest has posted since the promotion ended: 6 October through 14 October, 9 days.
4. Fixed-rate account; most recent payment 28 September; most recent interest charge 1 September: 29 September through 14 October, 16 days.
5. Fixed-rate account funded 2 September, no payment yet: 2 September through 14 October, 43 days.

An interest charge and a payment posted on the same day: the charge is not later than the payment, so the first case does not apply.
